sections.title: P07.3 — impersonation profiles and committed dual audit
sections.text:
Status: GREEN. Base commit `9f428a7c81a20c1948f21f20c4b6ad54b6fa9fe1`; product commit `e7917772` (`candidate-commit.txt`). The second commit carries only execution evidence and plan bookkeeping because post-commit contract guards, the candidate SHA, and the independent review must be recorded after the product anchor exists.

The kernel now provides `SynchronousAuditWriter` and its committed database implementation. Tenancy uses `ImpersonationGrantStore` and `ImpersonationAuditSink`, an atomic profile-aware claim, and a central-first/tenant-second sink. The `standard` profile is the default; `regulated` requires a staff approver in the claim predicate; `dev` requires production acknowledgement. Audit failure denies `start`, leaves no impersonation session, and consumes the grant. A tenant mirror failure retains the committed central intent under D100. The scoped write guard restores its allowance after nested calls and exceptions. The runtime globals baseline is `{}`.

Validation: 27 profile matrix cells / 55 assertions; focused impersonation 40 passed / 172 assertions; stock writer 2 passed; full tenancy 589 passed, 6 existing Redis skips / 2200 assertions; root PG 242 passed / 1156 assertions; all 21 package suites passed. Runtime globals positive and injected `now()` negative passed. Removed `require_approved_by` grep is empty. PHP API write twice was byte identical and its check passed; full BC check passed with two exact D96/D100 `ImpersonationPolicy` approvals against the accepted historical base. Golden passed 4 snapshots / 1440 assertions with 11 added, zero removed and 4 changed semantic entries. Root lint, analyse, anti-weakening, package docs, configuration reference, and both post-commit contract guards passed. Logs and the semantic delta are in this directory.

The product commit includes the generated public API reference, configuration metadata, removal of stale PHPStan baseline entries, exact BC approvals, and formatting of two older P07 proof scripts needed for the root lint gate. Golden rebaseline documentation records the P07.3 change. These supporting files are tied to the declared package surfaces and validation.

The systemic invariant model and adversarial self-check are in `../P07.3/invariant-model.md` and `../P07.3/self-check.json`.

review: self-check GREEN

Independent review: `grok/grok-4.7/500000` returned GREEN with zero findings in the first round. The final verdict and exact current candidate digest are retained in `../P07.3/owner-review/`; the second round includes this completed note in the declared Files inventory.
